chunks: All those who are in the heavens and the earth are His, and they are all obedient to Him.
ai.seo_question: Who is obedient to God according to Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah, where 'Qunut' (submissiveness) encompasses both the angels and all creation, reflecting the cosmic order of Tawhid. It serves as a foundational proof for the unity of divine command, illustrating that every entity, whether conscious or not, is inherently bound to His will.
